sentences.en: are reshaping U.S.-China relations in ways we really haven't seen between two superpowers since the end of the Cold War.

sentences.en: The reason for these controls, according to BIS, was to put a stop to China's military modernization and human rights abuses.
sentences.zh: 根据BIS的说法，实施这些控制的原因是为了阻止中国的军事现代化和侵犯人权行为。

sentences.en: BIS is so small that its budget amounts to what is basically a rounding error for the Pentagon, about one-eighth the cost of a single Patriot missile battery.

sentences.en: And so, it's remarkable that this office is responsible for overseeing, theoretically,

sentences.zh: 无论是在国内还是国外，这真是令人瞩目。

sentences.en: And that it essentially established a non-proliferation regime for chips.

sentences.en: So, nearly every electronic device runs on some kind of chip.
sentences.zh: 所以，几乎每一个电子设备都靠某种芯片运行。

sentences.en: And to put it simply, a chip is just a piece of silicon with transistors on it.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，芯片只是一块带有晶体管的硅片。

sentences.en: The main chip on your iPhone could have 20 billion transistors, and they're each the size of a virus.

sentences.en: But these aren't the chips that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这些并不是美国

sentences.en: is so concerned about China obtaining.
sentences.zh: 如此担心中国获取的芯片。

sentences.en: Instead, it's the cutting-edge chips that are used to run supercomputers, power artificial intelligence, and most importantly,
sentences.zh: 相反，它是用于运行超级计算机、驱动人工智能的最前沿芯片，最重要的是

sentences.en: help develop smart weapons that might be deployed on a future battlefield.
sentences.zh: 帮助开发可能部署在未来战场上的智能武器。

sentences.en: There are just a handful of countries involved in producing the most advanced chips, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 生产最先进芯片的国家只有寥寥几个，而美国

sentences.en: is really the linchpin.
sentences.zh: 确实是核心支柱。

sentences.en: Every advanced chip in the world is made, to some degree, with American knowledge and American technology.
sentences.zh: 世界上每一个先进的芯片，在某种程度上都是用美国知识和美国技术制造的。

sentences.en: And so, the goal of the October 7th controls was not just to stop China's technological development, but to reverse it, to pull the rug out from under them.
sentences.zh: 因此，10月7日管制的目地不仅是阻止中国的技术发展，而是要扭转它，釜底抽薪。

sentences.en: By declaring advanced chips a matter of national security, the Biden administration cut off the entire supply chain for China.
sentences.zh: 通过宣布先进芯片事关国家安全，拜登政府切断了中国的整个供应链。

sentences.en: It takes decades of research to master all of these dozens or hundreds of steps in the supply chain.
sentences.zh: 掌握供应链中这几十个或几百个步骤需要几十年的研究。

sentences.en: And now China is trying to play catch-up.
sentences.zh: 而现在中国正试图急起直追。

sentences.en: They're investing tens of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们正在投资数百亿美元。

sentences.en: In a way, it's become a technological cold war.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这已经成为了一场技术冷战。

sentences.en: Will China catch up?

sentences.en: Last October, the United States Bureau of Industry and Security issued a document that, underneath its 139 pages of dense bureaucratic jargon and minute technical detail,
sentences.zh: 去年10月，美国商务部工业与安全局发布了一份文件，在其139页的密集官僚行话和微小技术细节背后，

sentences.en: amounted to a declaration of economic war on China.
sentences.zh: 无异于对中国宣战。

sentences.en: The magnitude of the act was made all the more remarkable by the relative obscurity of its source.
sentences.zh: 这一举动的规模之大，与其来源的相对默默无闻形成了鲜明对比，更显非凡。

sentences.en: One of 13 bureaus within the Department of Commerce, the smallest federal department by funding, BIS, is tiny.
sentences.zh: 作为商务部下属的13个局之一，同时也是资金最少的联邦部门，BIS规模极小。

sentences.en: Its budget for 2022 was just over $140 million, about one-eighth the cost of a single Patriot air defense missile battery.
sentences.zh: 它在2022年的预算略超1.4亿美元，大约是一套“爱国者”防空导弹系统成本的八分之一。

sentences.en: The Bureau employs approximately 350 agents and officers who, collectively, monitor trillions of dollars' worth of transactions taking place all around the world.
sentences.zh: 该局拥有大约350名特工和官员，他们共同监控着世界各地价值数万亿美元的交易。

sentences.en: During the height of the Cold War, when export controls to the Soviet bloc were at their strictest,
sentences.zh: 在冷战高潮时期，当时对苏联集团的出口管制最为严格，

sentences.en: BIS was a critical hub in the Western defenses, processing up to 100,000 export licenses annually.
sentences.zh: BIS是西方防御的核心枢纽，每年处理多达10万份出口许可证。

sentences.en: During the relative peace and stability of the 1990s, the Bureau lost some of its raison d'être, as well as staff and funding, and licenses shriveled to roughly 10,000 per year.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代相对和平与稳定的时期，该局失去了一些存在意义，以及员工和资金，许可证数量锐减至每年大约1万份。

sentences.en: To date, the number is 40,000 and climbing.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止，这个数字是40,000并且还在攀升。

sentences.en: With a sprawling trade blacklist known as the Entity List, currently 662 pages and counting, numerous pre-existing multilateral export control agreements,
sentences.zh: 凭借一份庞大的贸易黑名单（即实体清单，目前已长达662页且仍在增加）、众多现有的多边出口管制协议，

sentences.en: and ongoing actions against Russia and China,
sentences.zh: 以及针对俄罗斯和中国的持续行动，

sentences.en: BIS is busier than ever.
sentences.zh: BIS比以往任何时候都更加忙碌。

sentences.en: We spend 100% of our time on Russia sanctions, another 100% on China, and the other 100% on everything else, says Matt Borman,
sentences.zh: 我们100%的时间花在对俄制裁上，另外100%花在对华上，剩下的100%花在其他所有事情上，负责出口管理的商务部副助理部长

sentences.en: the Deputy Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Export Administration.
sentences.zh: 马特·博尔曼说。

sentences.en: In recent years, semiconductor chips have become central to the Bureau's work.
sentences.zh: 近年来，半导体芯片已成为该局工作的核心。

sentences.en: Chips are the lifeblood of the modern economy, and the brains of every electronic device and system, from iPhones to toasters, data centers to credit cards.
sentences.zh: 芯片是现代经济的生命线，也是从iPhone到烤面包机、数据中心到信用卡的每一个电子设备和大马力的智囊。

sentences.en: A new car might have more than 1,000 chips, each one managing a different facet of the vehicle's operation.
sentences.zh: 一台新车可能拥有1000多个芯片，每一个都管理着车辆运作的不同方面。

sentences.en: Semiconductors are also the driving force behind the innovations poised to revolutionize life over the next century, like quantum computing and artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 半导体也是推动未来一个世纪将彻底改变生活的创新的动力源泉，比如量子计算和人工智能。

sentences.en: OpenAI's ChatGPT, for example, was reportedly trained on 10,000 of the most advanced chips currently available.
sentences.zh: 例如，据报道，OpenAI的ChatGPT就是在目前可用的10,000个最先进芯片上训练出来的。

sentences.en: With the October 7th export controls, the United States government announced its intent to cripple China's ability to produce, or even purchase, the highest-end chips.
sentences.zh: 通过10月7日的出口管制，美国政府宣布了削弱中国生产甚至购买高端芯片能力的意图。

sentences.en: The logic of the measure was straightforward.
sentences.zh: 该措施的逻辑很简单。

sentences.en: Advanced chips, And the supercomputers and AI systems they power enable the production of new weapons and surveillance apparatuses.
sentences.zh: 先进芯片以及它们驱动的超级计算机和人工智能系统，使得生产新武器和监视设备成为可能。

sentences.en: In their reach and meaning, however, the measures could hardly have been more sweeping, taking aim at a target far broader than the Chinese security state.
sentences.zh: 然而，从其范围和意义来看，这些措施再广泛不过了，其打击的目标远远超出了中国安全部门的范畴。

sentences.en: The key here is to understand that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这里的关键是要理解美国

sentences.en: wanted to impact China's AI industry, says Gregory C.
sentences.zh: 想要对中国的AI产业产生影响，位于华盛顿的战略与国际研究中心人工智能与先进技术瓦德瓦尼中心主任

sentences.en: Allen, director of the Wadwani Center for AI and Advanced Technologies at the Center for Strategic and International Studies in Washington.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里·C·艾伦说。

sentences.en: The semiconductor stuff is the means to that end.
sentences.zh: 半导体这些东西是实现这一目标的手段。

sentences.en: Though delivered in the unassuming form of updated export rules, the October 7th controls essentially seek to eradicate, root and branch,
sentences.zh: 尽管10月7日的管制以更新后的出口规则这种谦逊的形式发布，但其实质是试图斩草除根，

sentences.en: China's entire ecosystem of advanced technology.
sentences.zh: 彻底铲除中国的整个高科技生态系统。

sentences.en: The new policy embodied in October 7th is, not only are we not going to allow China to progress any further technologically,
sentences.zh: 10月7日体现的新政策不仅是我们不允许中国在技术上有任何进一步的发展，

sentences.en: we are going to actively reverse their current state of the art,
sentences.zh: 我们要积极逆转他们目前的技术水平，

sentences.zh: 艾伦说。

sentences.en: C.J.
sentences.zh: 埃弗科集团ISI的高级半导体分析师

sentences.zh: C·J·缪斯这样表述：

sentences.en: If you'd told me about these rules five years ago, I would have told you that's an act of war.
sentences.zh: 如果你五年前告诉我这些规则，我会告诉你那是战争行为。

sentences.en: We'd have to be at war.
sentences.zh: 我们得处于战争状态才行。

sentences.en: If the controls are successful, they could handicap China for a generation.
sentences.zh: 如果这些管制成功，可能会让中国倒退一代人。

sentences.en: If they fail, they may backfire spectacularly, hastening the very future the United States is trying desperately to avoid.
sentences.zh: 如果失败，可能会产生灾难性的反效果，反而加速了美国极力想避免的未来。

sentences.en: The outcome will likely shape U.S.-China competition and the future of the global order for decades to come.
sentences.zh: 这一结果可能会塑造未来几十年的美中竞争和全球秩序的未来。

sentences.en: There are two dates that will echo in history from 2022,

sentences.en: And the second is October 7th.
sentences.zh: 第二个是10月7日。

sentences.en: Despite the immense intricacy of their design, semiconductors are, in a sense, quite simple.
sentences.zh: 尽管设计极其复杂，但从某种意义上说，半导体其实很简单。

sentences.en: Tiny pieces of silicon carved with arrays of circuits.
sentences.zh: 雕刻着电路阵列的微小硅片。

sentences.en: The circuits flip on and off based on the activity of switches called transistors.
sentences.zh: 电路根据被称为晶体管的开关的活动来开启和关闭。

sentences.en: When a circuit is on, it produces a one.
sentences.zh: 当电路接通时，它产生一个1。

sentences.en: Off, a zero.
sentences.zh: 断开时，产生一个0。

sentences.en: The first chips, invented in the late 1950s, held only a handful of transistors.
sentences.zh: 发明于上世纪50年代末的首批芯片仅包含寥寥几个晶体管。

sentences.en: Today, the primary semiconductor in a new smartphone has between 10 and 20 billion transistors, each about the size of a virus, carved like a layer cake
sentences.zh: 如今，新智能手机中的主要半导体拥有100亿到200亿个晶体管，每个晶体管都有病毒那么大，像层蛋糕一样雕刻在

sentences.en: into the structure of the silicon.
sentences.zh: 硅的结构中。

sentences.en: The rate of progress over the last six decades has been famously described by Moore's Law, which observed that the number of transistors that can be fit on a chip

sentences.en: has roughly doubled every two years.
sentences.zh: 大约每两年翻一番。

sentences.en: Chris Miller, author of the book Chip War, and an associate professor of international history at the Fletcher School at Tufts University, likes to note that
sentences.zh: 《芯片战争》一书的作者、塔夫茨大学弗莱彻学院国际历史副教授克里斯·米勒喜欢指出，

sentences.en: if airplanes had improved at the same rate as chips, they'd now be flying at several times the speed of light.
sentences.zh: 如果飞机的改进速度和芯片一样，它们现在的飞行速度将是光速的好几倍。

sentences.en: No technology in the history of human civilization has ever matched the breathtaking ascent of computing power.
sentences.zh: 人类文明史上的任何技术都从未赶得上计算能力这惊人的攀升速度。

sentences.en: Semiconductor manufacturing plants, known as FABs, are the most expensive factories in the world, conducting the most complex manufacturing ever accomplished
sentences.zh: 被称为晶圆厂的半导体制造厂是世界上最昂贵的工厂，进行着有史以来最复杂的制造

sentences.en: at a scale of production never before achieved with any other device.
sentences.zh: 以任何其他设备从未达到过的生产规模进行。

sentences.en: The wider chip industry, meanwhile, is a web of mutual interdependence, spread all over the planet in highly specialized regions and companies, its feats made possible
sentences.zh: 与此同时，更广泛的芯片产业是一个相互依存的网络，分布在全球高度专业化的地区和公司中，其壮举之所以成为可能

sentences.en: by supply chains of exceptional length and complexity, a poster child, in other words, for globalization.
sentences.zh: 靠的是异常漫长且复杂的供应链，换句话说，它是全球化的典型代表。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine how the capabilities they've reached would be possible without access to the smartest minds in the world all working together,
sentences.zh: 很难想象，如果没有世界上最聪明的大脑齐心协力，他们所达到的能力怎么可能实现，

sentences.en: Miller says.
sentences.zh: 米勒说。

sentences.en: And yet, it is this same interconnectedness that makes the industry vulnerable to regulations like those the Biden administration is pursuing.
sentences.zh: 然而，正是这种互联性，使得该行业容易受到拜登政府正在推行的那些法规的攻击。

sentences.en: Only a small handful of companies can compete at the cutting edge, where breakthroughs cost billions of dollars and decades of research.
sentences.zh: 只有极少数公司能够在最前沿竞争，那里的突破需要数十亿美元和几十年的研究。

sentences.en: The result is an industry structured as a series of choke points.
sentences.zh: 其结果是一个被构造成一系列咽喉要道的产业。

sentences.zh: 最知名的例子是由荷兰制造集团阿斯麦制造的极紫外EUV光刻机，它用于打印芯片的各层。

sentences.zh: 让团队制造出一台原型机。

sentences.zh: 2010年12月，在韩国的一家研究设施中，一个更新的原型机，即双工作台NXE 3100，终于迎来了它的首次成功试运行。

sentences.en: It would be nearly another decade before the first EUV-enabled products would go to market.
sentences.zh: 距离第一批启用EUV的产品上市还要将近十年时间。

sentences.zh: 该机器的最新版本可以制造小至10纳米的结构。

sentences.zh: 相比之下，人类的红细胞直径约为7,000纳米。
